name: plugin-process-hygiene-convergence
description: Tier-P F1 adversarial transient-hook-client contract proof against a synthetic mock, not a product runtime. Stdlib networking and the shared agent-procutil test-instance lifecycle exercise six real-process floods: live and absent daemon, mid-flood appearance, mid-packet death, singleton contention, and repeated-flood process counts. Every mock daemon inherits finite test custody; transient clients remain lightweight. Real per-plugin conformance remains issue #2301. Name-free and credential-free.
